t: Persistent ClaudeCode configuration advisor with hub distribution
description: Claude Code starts blank every session. The existing wai-claude-maximizer (at templates/commands/wai-claude-maximizer.md) does point-in-time audits of 8 CC config areas but has no memory — it can't detect regressions, track trends, or proactively surface improvements. The ClaudeCode advisor replaces the maximizer with a persistent advisor. At spoke level: observes CC activity, scores the same 8-area rubric, tracks score history, detects regressions, proposes configuration improvements. At hub level: aggregates cross-spoke CC patterns and redistributes validated improvements as teachings.
challenge: CC configuration drifts silently between sessions. The maximizer detects gaps but only when manually invoked. No historical tracking means regressions go unnoticed. No cross-spoke aggregation means each spoke rediscovers the same improvements independently.
hypothesis: If we formalize the maximizer as a persistent advisor with observation logs, score history, regression vectors, and hub-level aggregation via the existing signal/teaching pipeline, then CC config quality improves automatically across the fleet — each spoke learns from itself over time, and the hub amplifies learnings across all spokes.

existing_files_to_absorb.maximizer_skill: templates/commands/wai-claude-maximizer.md (8-area rubric, trigger conditions, gap report format, fix mode)
existing_files_to_absorb.maximizer_skill_entry: WAI-Spoke/skills/WAI-Skills.jsonl line 32 (id: claude-maximizer, type: guard, advisory: true)
existing_files_to_absorb.existing_settings: .claude/settings.json (hooks config, deny rules — no allow rules yet)
existing_files_to_absorb.state_file: WAI-Spoke/WAI-State.json (spoke identity, phase, session count, module adoption)

advisor_pattern_reference.what_is_an_advisor: A WAI advisor is a persistent agent that lives at WAI-Spoke/advisors/{name}/ (spoke level) or WAI-Hub/advisors/{name}/ (hub level). It has its own state files, runs periodically, and produces reports. It reads shared infrastructure but writes only to its own folder.
advisor_pattern_reference.historian_example: WAI-Spoke/advisors/historian/ has: scan_state.json (watermark — last scan session, total scanned), passes.jsonl (one line per review — sessions reviewed, patterns detected, vectors created), vectors.jsonl (detected patterns with lifecycle: watching→confirmed→dismissed), reviews/ (human-readable reports). The historian scans session tracks for recurring patterns.
advisor_pattern_reference.gardener_example: WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/ has: scan_state.json (per-spoke last_tended, health status), passes.jsonl (per-run summary + token usage), vectors.jsonl (per-spoke health scores with evals), reports/ (nightly fleet reports), scripts/ (cron entry point), logs/ (per-spoke execution logs). The gardener tends all spokes nightly.

scan_state_json.description: Watermark for the CC advisor — when it last ran, current score, next scheduled audit

passes_jsonl.description: One JSONL line per audit pass — score, findings, actions taken

vectors_jsonl.description: Tracked patterns — regressions, recurring friction, improvement opportunities

hub_path_resolution: Read WAI-State.json field wheel.hub_path at runtime. Example: /home/mario/projects/wheelwright/hub. All Phase 5 paths like {hub_path}/WAI-Hub/advisors/cc-advisor/ resolve from this field.
agent_file_format: A .claude/agents/*.md file is a markdown file read by the Claude CLI when --agent flag is used or when the Agent tool references it. Structure: H1 title, role description paragraph, then numbered steps or sections describing what the agent should do. No special frontmatter. See .claude/agents/lug-reviewer.md (7 lines) or hub/.claude/agents/ozi-gardener.md (322 lines) for examples.

data.verb: first word of bash command or null

audit_trigger_mechanism: The session-start hook (WAI-Spoke/_hooks/session-start.sh or .claude/hooks/user-prompt-submit.sh) reads scan_state.json, increments sessions_since_last_audit, and writes it back. When count >= 10, it sets a flag that the cc-advisor skill reads at wakeup to trigger a full audit pass.

acceptance_criteria_per_phase.phase_1: scan_state.json exists and valid JSON. cc-advisor.md skill loads without error. /wai-claude-maximizer still invokes scoring (backward compat). WAI-Skills.jsonl has cc-advisor entry, no maximizer entry.
acceptance_criteria_per_phase.phase_2: After 3 sessions, permission-prompts.jsonl has entries. session-events.jsonl has start/end pairs. hook-events.jsonl has at least one entry per configured hook.
acceptance_criteria_per_phase.phase_3: After 10 sessions, passes.jsonl has at least 1 audit entry. Manually lowering a score and running next audit creates a regression vector in vectors.jsonl.
acceptance_criteria_per_phase.phase_4: A read-only command prompted 3+ sessions gets auto-added to settings.json permissions.allow. A CLAUDE.md gap generates a proposal in reports/. Wakeup shows top gaps.
acceptance_criteria_per_phase.phase_5: WAI-Hub/advisors/cc-advisor/ exists. A signal emitted by 2 spokes produces a teaching in teachings_repo/spoke/current/. Weekly report generated.

signal_and_teaching_pipeline.how_signals_work: A signal is a high-impact lug (impact >= 8) stored at WAI-Spoke/lugs/bytype/signal/undelivered/{id}.json. At closeout (Step 9c), undelivered signals are copied to {hub_path}/WAI-Hub/signals/incoming/. The hub processes them on its next run.
signal_and_teaching_pipeline.how_teachings_work: A teaching is a .teaching file at {hub_path}/teachings_repo/spoke/current/. Spokes discover new teachings at wakeup (Step 5). Auto-adoptable teachings (safe_to_auto_adopt: true) can be applied without manual review.
signal_and_teaching_pipeline.cc_advisor_usage: Hub CC advisor generates teachings for validated cross-spoke improvements. Spoke CC advisor emits signals for hub-relevant findings. No parallel distribution mechanism needed.

phases.name: Foundation — advisor skeleton + maximizer absorption
items: Create WAI-Spoke/advisors/cc-advisor/ with scan_state.json (see new_file_schemas), empty passes.jsonl, empty vectors.jsonl, reports/ dir
Create WAI-Spoke/skills/cc-advisor/cc-advisor.md — absorb rubric from templates/commands/wai-claude-maximizer.md, add advisor lifecycle (periodic audit, score tracking, regression detection)
Create WAI-Spoke/skills/cc-advisor/cc-advisor-reference.md — absorb from templates/commands/wai-claude-maximizer-reference.md, add event schemas, proposal format
Create .claude/agents/cc-advisor.md — agent that runs the skill's scoring logic, reads advisor state, writes results to scan_state + passes
Update WAI-Spoke/skills/WAI-Skills.jsonl — replace the claude-maximizer entry (id, command_file, objects paths) with cc-advisor entry

Redirect /wai-claude-maximizer: edit templates/commands/wai-claude-maximizer.md to a 3-line file that says 'This skill has been absorbed into the ClaudeCode advisor. Run /cc-advisor or read WAI-Spoke/skills/cc-advisor/cc-advisor.md.'

phases.name: Observation — permission friction, session metrics, hook health logging
items: Create WAI-Spoke/advisors/cc-advisor/logs/ directory for JSONL event streams
Add permission-prompts.jsonl logging: extend .claude/hooks/user-prompt-submit.sh to append {ts, session, event: 'permission_request', data: {tool, command, classification}} to advisor logs
Add session-events.jsonl logging: extend session-start hook to log session_start event; extend stop hook to log session_end with duration, tokens, context_pct, compact_count
Add hook-events.jsonl logging: each hook script appends {ts, hook_name, result: ok|fail, duration_ms} to advisor logs
All events use base schema: {ts, session, spoke, event, data} — spoke name read from WAI-State.json wheel.name

phases.name: Analysis — periodic audit with score history and regression detection
items: Add session counter to scan_state.json: increment sessions_since_last_audit at each session start; trigger full audit when count reaches 10
Audit pass: run 8-area scoring (same logic as maximizer), append result to passes.jsonl with score + delta + findings
Regression detection: if score_delta < 0, create a vector in vectors.jsonl with pattern_type: 'regression' and surface at next wakeup
Permission friction analysis: read permission-prompts.jsonl, identify top 3 most-prompted commands, classify as safe/review/deny candidates

phases.name: Adjustment — safe auto-apply, patch proposals, proactive advisory
items: Safe permission auto-apply: if a read-only command has been prompted 3+ sessions with zero write side-effects, auto-add to settings.json permissions.allow with notification to user
CLAUDE.md patch proposals: when audit finds missing sections or stale anti-patterns, generate a diff proposal stored in advisor reports/. Always require user approval.
Wakeup integration: at session start, if scan_state has pending_proposals or regression vectors, surface top 3 gaps as a brief note (one line each)
Signal emission: when a finding has impact >= 8 and applies beyond this spoke (e.g., new safe permission pattern), create a signal lug in bytype/signal/undelivered/ for hub delivery at closeout

phases.name: Hub integration — cross-spoke patterns, teaching distribution
items: Create WAI-Hub/advisors/cc-advisor/ with same structure as spoke advisor (scan_state, passes, vectors, reports)
Cross-spoke pattern detection: read signals from WAI-Hub/signals/incoming/ with cc-advisor origin; if 2+ spokes report same finding within 30 days, create a teaching candidate

Teaching generation: write validated improvements as .teaching files to teachings_repo/spoke/current/ with safe_to_auto_adopt: true for low-risk items (permission additions), false for CLAUDE.md/hook changes
Weekly fleet CC report: aggregate all spoke scores into WAI-Hub/advisors/cc-advisor/reports/weekly-YYYY-MM-DD.md
Gardener integration: add CC advisor audit as a step in hub/.claude/agents/ozi-gardener.md — after health remediation, run cc-advisor scoring on each spoke and update hub advisor state

design_principles: P3 Stewardship: observation before action — log everything before changing anything
Hooks over instructions — guaranteed behaviors are hooks, not CLAUDE.md prose
P3 Stewardship: propose don't impose — advisor proposes, user approves (except safe read-only auto-applies with notification)
Skill Thrift: lean primary, verbose reference on demand
P1 Persistence: WAI-State as source of truth — advisor reads phase/modules from state, writes findings to advisor folder
P10 Autonomy: fail safe — log failures and continue, never block sessions or corrupt configs

scoring_rubric.score_range: 0-8 (count of areas at or above ideal for spoke maturity)

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Epic to build the ClaudeCode advisor — a persistent WAI advisor that replaces the point-in-time maximizer with continuous CC config monitoring, historical tracking, and cross-spoke improvement distribution. Uses existing advisor pattern, signal pipeline, and teaching distribution.
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not a new system parallel to WAI. Not changing what the 8-area rubric measures — only how it runs (persistent vs on-demand). Not creating parallel distribution mechanisms — uses teachings_repo.
